title: CPL Aromas explores the new appetite for neo-gourmand and umami scents at Asia Perfume Show
summary: CPL Aromas took part as a Major Partner of Asia Perfume Show, held from 23–25 September at the Bastille Design Center in Paris, bringing a distinctly Asian perspective to one of perfumery’s most compelling creative shifts: the evolution of gourmand fragrance
